scope: Epic 1 first implementation target only: discovery, indexing, vault mode, state, update/sync/status/remove semantics, and TTY UX while preserving current Pi behavior.
global_constraints: Implement exactly one task per agent run.
Read PLAN.md and relevant source/tests before editing.
Preserve existing Pi-only project behavior unless the task explicitly changes it.
Use tests-first development for behavior changes where practical.
Keep path and symlink security protections at least as strict as current behavior.
Do not implement deferred Epic 2 cross-agent adapter behavior in this task set.
Do not implement deferred Epic 3/4 release, installer, governance, or branch-protection work in this task set.

tasks.title: Lock current Pi behavior with baseline contract tests
tasks.objective: Add or tighten tests around current behavior that Epic 1 must preserve before refactoring begins.
steps: Inspect existing CLI, catalog, project, source, manifest, and security tests.
Add missing contract tests for current Pi target paths, add/remove/sync behavior, duplicate source handling, and legacy manifest behavior.
Avoid implementation rewrites except minimal fixes needed for the new tests to reflect existing intended behavior.
acceptance: Tests document current .pi/skills install/remove/sync expectations.
Tests document current source repo and duplicate-skill behavior.
Security-sensitive path and symlink expectations remain covered.
checks: Run the focused tests you changed
Run the smallest relevant existing test subset

tasks.title: Add versioned TOML document helpers
tasks.objective: Create shared helpers for reading and writing simple versioned TOML files used by indexes and manifests.
steps: Introduce small internal utilities for schema_version checks, TOML string escaping, atomic text writes, and user-friendly parse errors.
Support explicit handling for unsupported future schemas and safe old-schema migration hooks.
Move duplicated TOML escaping only when doing so is low-risk and well covered.
acceptance: Future schema versions produce actionable update messages instead of low-level tracebacks.
Atomic writes avoid leaving partially written state files.
Existing config and manifest tests continue to pass.
checks: Run existing config and manifest tests

tasks.title: Add safe content hashing utilities
tasks.objective: Provide deterministic file and directory hashing for skill content without weakening path safety.
steps: Implement sha256 hashing helpers for files and skill directories.
Use stable relative paths, file modes where appropriate, and deterministic traversal ordering.
Reject or surface symlinks and unsafe paths consistently with existing project/source security behavior.
acceptance: Identical skill trees hash identically regardless of filesystem iteration order.
Changed file content changes the directory hash.
Symlink and unsafe path cases are rejected or skipped according to existing security rules.

tasks.title: Add atomic skill materialization helpers
tasks.objective: Centralize atomic install/replace behavior for selected skill folders so later backend work can reuse it.
steps: Extract or introduce helpers for temp-directory copy, target rename, rollback, and cleanup.
Keep add/remove/sync rollback behavior at least as safe as current project.py behavior.
Make helpers usable with materialized temp folders from future backends.
acceptance: A failed copy leaves the existing target skill intact.
A failed manifest update rolls back the filesystem replacement.
Existing add/remove/sync tests still pass.

tasks.title: Generalize source skill catalog models around source paths
tasks.objective: Stop assuming every source skill lives at skills/<name> while preserving existing output.
steps: Update SourceSkill or introduce a catalog entry model with explicit source_path and source_relative_path fields.
Ensure same-name entries from the same repo can be distinguished by source path.
Keep current simple skills/<name> repos working.
acceptance: Catalog entries can represent skills in skills/, */skills/, and configured deep roots.
Display labels and qualified references have enough source path information for duplicate resolution.
Existing catalog duplicate tests continue to pass or are updated to the new path-aware contract.

tasks.title: Implement canonical project .sv/manifest.toml model
tasks.objective: Create the canonical project manifest at .sv/manifest.toml with schema_version and fields needed by update/sync/status.
steps: Add reader/writer for project-root .sv/manifest.toml without deleting the legacy reader yet.
Track managed skills with target kind, target agent when applicable, target path, source repo details, source path, hashes, description, and state flags where available.
Keep serialization deterministic for clean diffs.
acceptance: .sv/manifest.toml round-trips valid managed skill entries.
Future schema errors are actionable.
Empty manifests are handled cleanly.

tasks.title: Read and migrate legacy Pi manifests on next write
tasks.objective: Maintain compatibility with .pi/skills/.sv-manifest.toml while moving writes to .sv/manifest.toml.
steps: Load canonical project manifest first when present.
Fall back to the legacy Pi manifest when canonical state does not exist.
On the next manifest write, persist canonical .sv/manifest.toml with migrated entries.
acceptance: Existing legacy projects continue to sync/update/remove correctly.
The next write creates canonical state without losing origin data.
Manual/unmanaged skills remain unmanaged.

tasks.title: Switch project add/remove to canonical manifest writes
tasks.objective: Update normal project install/remove flows to use .sv/manifest.toml as the canonical managed-skill state.
steps: Update add_project_skill and remove_project_skill to write canonical manifest entries after successful file operations.
Ensure manifest writes still roll back filesystem changes on failure.
Keep Pi target directory behavior unchanged for normal projects.
acceptance: Normal project sv add writes .sv/manifest.toml.
Normal project sv remove removes only the matching managed manifest entry.
Legacy manifests are not required for new writes.

tasks.title: Add global source-state manifest
tasks.objective: Create ~/.sv/manifest.toml support for per-source catalog/backend/index refresh state.
steps: Add schema-versioned global manifest reader/writer under SvPaths.
Track configured repo id/url, last refresh metadata, backend name, index/catalog hashes, and health details as available.
Do not store project installation state in the global manifest.
acceptance: Global source state round-trips deterministic TOML.
Missing global manifest is treated as empty state.
Source state is separate from project managed-skill state.

tasks.title: Support configured explicit source skills paths
tasks.objective: Allow repos to store repeated explicit skills-path roots for deep generic repositories.
steps: Add a tuple/list of skills_paths to RepoConfig with safe relative path validation.
Parse and write skills_paths in ~/.sv/config.toml.
Preserve backwards compatibility with existing config files and repo aliases.
acceptance: Repeated skills_paths round-trip through config.
Absolute paths, parent traversal, empty paths, and control characters are rejected.
Existing config files without skills_paths continue to load.
checks: Run security path tests if touched

tasks.title: Add sv repo add --skills-path CLI handling
tasks.objective: Expose repeated --skills-path flags on sv repo add while keeping repo list output simple.
steps: Update argparse for sv repo add to accept repeated --skills-path values.
Store paths in RepoConfig through add_repo.
Keep sv repo list focused on repo/url/cache and do not expose indexed/generic mode by default.
acceptance: sv repo add owner/repo --skills-path packages/agents/pi/skills stores the path.
Multiple --skills-path flags are preserved in order without duplicates if that is the chosen config behavior.
Invalid skills paths produce helpful CLI errors.

tasks.title: Implement .sv/index.toml parser and writer
tasks.objective: Add schema-versioned index support for skill-vault and project-index repos.
steps: Create index data models for schema_version, kind, generated metadata, and skills entries.
Parse skill entries with name, description, source_path, content_hash, and skill_file_hash.
Write deterministic TOML and handle unsupported future schema versions clearly.
acceptance: Valid skill-vault and project-index files parse successfully.
Duplicate skill names with different source_path entries are allowed.
Unsupported future schema prompts users to update sv.

tasks.title: Add sv index recursive scanner
tasks.objective: Implement sv index to recursively scan a Git repo for valid SKILL.md files and write .sv/index.toml.
steps: Add sv index command and handler.
Scan recursively while skipping .git, .sv, .venv, node_modules, dist, build, __pycache__, and other common cache/build directories.
Include known agent project skill directories such as .pi/skills and manually-created valid skills.
Warn and skip invalid skills.
acceptance: sv index writes .sv/index.toml with valid entries and hashes.
Invalid skills warn and do not stop indexing unless a hard filesystem error occurs.
Duplicate names with different source paths are included.

tasks.title: Implement README generated skill table updater
tasks.objective: Update only the sv-generated README block for skill-vault repositories.
steps: Add helper for markers <!-- sv:skills:start --> and <!-- sv:skills:end -->.
Generate a Markdown table with Skill and Description columns from current valid indexed skills.
Preserve all user-authored README content outside the markers.
acceptance: Existing README text outside markers is unchanged.
Missing markers can be created where sv init needs them.
Only skill-vault mode updates README automatically.

tasks.title: Implement sv init for skill-vault repos
tasks.objective: Add sv init [folder] to create a skill-vault repository scaffold.
steps: Create target folder if needed and initialize Git if target is not already a Git repo.
Create skills/, .sv/index.toml with kind skill-vault, .sv/manifest.toml as needed, and README markers/table.
Do not create a sample skill.
acceptance: sv init works in the current folder.
sv init folder-name creates and initializes the target folder.
Existing Git repos are not reinitialized destructively.

tasks.title: Detect skill-vault mode and route targets
tasks.objective: Use .sv/index.toml kind=skill-vault to install/remove root vault skills instead of Pi project skills.
steps: Add context detection for nearest Git root and .sv/index.toml kind.
In skill-vault mode, route add/remove/update/sync targets to skills/<skill> at repo root.
In normal project mode, preserve current Pi target behavior.
acceptance: Vault sv add installs to root skills/<skill>.
Normal project sv add still installs to .pi/skills/<skill>.
Command output makes vault target behavior obvious.

tasks.title: Refresh index and README after mutating commands
tasks.objective: Keep existing .sv/index.toml and skill-vault README generated blocks current after local skill changes.
steps: After add/remove/update/sync, refresh .sv/index.toml only when it already exists or the repo is a skill-vault.
Refresh README generated block only when kind=skill-vault.
Do not implicitly create .sv/index.toml for normal project operations unless it already exists.
acceptance: Normal project add without existing index does not create .sv/index.toml.
Normal project add with existing index refreshes it.
Vault mutations refresh both index and README generated block.

tasks.title: Introduce lightweight source backend interface
tasks.objective: Create backend abstractions so list/search can avoid persistent full clones.
steps: Define interfaces for reading remote files, listing candidate SKILL.md files, reading indexes, and materializing selected folders.
Represent backend names and failure details for user-facing messages and global state.
Keep a fake backend path easy to test without network.
acceptance: Source discovery can be tested without invoking git or network commands.
Backend failures are collected and reported actionably.
No full-clone fallback is introduced by the abstraction.

tasks.title: Implement GitHub gh api backend
tasks.objective: Use gh api as the lightest backend when available and authenticated for GitHub sources.
steps: Parse supported GitHub repo URLs into owner/repo references.
Use gh api to read .sv/index.toml, candidate SKILL.md files, and selected folder contents.
Detect gh absence/auth/rate-limit failures and return structured fallback reasons.
acceptance: gh api backend is selected before HTTPS and Git fallbacks when usable.
Private repos can use existing gh auth.
Rate-limit/auth messages recommend gh auth login or GH_TOKEN where helpful.
checks: Run source backend tests with fake runner

tasks.title: Implement direct GitHub HTTPS API fallback
tasks.objective: Support unauthenticated or token-authenticated GitHub API reads without gh.
steps: Read .sv/index.toml and candidate SKILL.md files through GitHub HTTPS API endpoints.
Honor GH_TOKEN or equivalent environment token if already present without prompting.
On rate limits or auth failures, return structured fallback reasons for Git backends.
acceptance: HTTPS backend can list indexed and bounded generic skills in tests using fake HTTP responses.
Rate-limit fallback behavior is covered.
No full folder downloads occur during list/search.

tasks.title: Implement lightweight Git fallback without full clones
tasks.objective: Provide treeless/blobless sparse Git fallback paths while never silently full-cloning.
steps: Use partial clone, sparse checkout, archive-style extraction, or equivalent lightweight Git commands for metadata and selected folder materialization.
Prefer treeless partial Git, then blobless sparse Git, matching PLAN.md backend order as closely as practical.
Fail helpfully if lightweight methods fail instead of running git clone without filters.
acceptance: Tests assert no plain full-clone command is used silently.
Git fallback can fetch index/SKILL.md metadata and selected folders in fake-runner tests.
Source cache symlink protections remain intact.

tasks.title: Wire indexed discovery into list/search catalogs
tasks.objective: Use .sv/index.toml as the trusted fast path for sv list and sv search.
steps: For each configured source, try .sv/index.toml first through the backend chain.
If present and supported, build catalog entries from the index without downloading full skill folders.
If a previously indexed source loses its index, fall back to generic discovery next refresh.
acceptance: Indexed GitHub source lists skills without full clone or full folder downloads.
Unsupported future index schema tells the user to update sv.
Missing index falls back to generic discovery instead of hard failing.

tasks.title: Implement generic bounded fallback discovery
tasks.objective: Discover valid skills in generic repos by reading only bounded candidate SKILL.md files.
steps: Search default roots skills/ and */skills/ plus configured skills_paths.
Fetch only candidate SKILL.md files during list/search.
Validate frontmatter name/description, folder-name match, and safe paths before showing entries.
acceptance: Generic discovery finds skills/ and one-level */skills/ layouts.
Deep layouts require an index or explicit --skills-path config.
Invalid candidate skills warn/skip and are not listed.

tasks.title: Materialize only selected skill folders
tasks.objective: Ensure sv add, update, and sync download only the selected skill folder before atomic install/replace.
steps: Add backend materialization into an operation temp directory for a selected catalog entry.
Validate safe paths and SKILL.md after materialization and before install/replace.
Compute content hashes before updating manifests.
acceptance: Adding one skill does not persistently cache full skill folders by default.
Materialized folders are validated before local files are changed.
Manifest state updates only after successful filesystem operations.

tasks.title: Add sv search command with ranked non-TTY output
tasks.objective: Implement sv search <query> over source catalog metadata with scriptable output first.
steps: Search skill name, description, repo id, and source path.
Use case-insensitive text matching with lightweight fuzzy ranking.
Print plain ranked results in non-TTY mode using existing table conventions.
acceptance: sv search <query> returns ranked matching source entries.
Repo id and source path can match results.
No full skill folders are downloaded for search.

tasks.title: Implement first-run source configuration behavior
tasks.objective: Handle missing global repo config according to TTY and non-TTY rules without hardcoding permanent release defaults.
steps: When no config exists in a TTY, prompt with pluggable recommended sources.
When no config exists in non-TTY, fail helpfully with sv repo add <repo> guidance.
Treat repos = [] as explicit no-source configuration.
acceptance: Non-TTY no-config commands do not silently use HamdiMaz/Skills as a permanent default.
repos = [] disables all sources and is not treated as missing config.
Recommended source list is centralized/configurable for release-time decisions.

tasks.title: Track local hashes and modified/update states
tasks.objective: Use content hashes to distinguish unchanged, locally modified, update-available, and orphan candidates.
steps: Store installed source content hash and last checked local content hash in canonical manifest entries.
Compare current local content hash to last installed/synced hash before update/sync decisions.
Keep state flags deterministic and visible to later status output.
acceptance: Unchanged managed skills are recognized by hash.
Local edits are detected without comparing timestamps.
Hash fields update only after successful installs/replacements.

tasks.title: Implement sv update preserve-local-edits semantics
tasks.objective: Change sv update to refresh source metadata and update only unmodified managed local skills.
steps: Refresh source metadata through lightweight backends.
Skip replacement when local content hash differs from the last installed/synced hash.
Mark modified and update-available states when relevant, then refresh index/README when applicable.
acceptance: sv update updates unchanged managed skills when remote changed.
sv update does not overwrite local user edits.
sv update skips unchanged remote skills without unnecessary downloads/replacements.

tasks.title: Implement sv sync force-reset semantics
tasks.objective: Make sv sync restore sv-managed skills to latest source state even when local edits exist.
steps: Refresh source metadata through lightweight backends.
For existing source entries, materialize latest selected skill folders and replace local managed folders even if modified.
Clear modified/update-available state after successful replacement.
acceptance: sv sync replaces locally modified managed skills from source.
sv sync does not remove orphan local files automatically.
Manifest hashes and state reflect the new source after replacement.

tasks.title: Implement orphan tracking and reattachment
tasks.objective: Mark missing source skills as orphan without deleting local files and reattach when they reappear.
steps: During update/sync/status, detect manifest-managed skills whose recorded repo/path/name no longer exists in the refreshed catalog.
Persist orphan state in .sv/manifest.toml and show it in relevant command output.
When the same repo/path/name reappears, clear orphan state and resume normal behavior.
acceptance: Orphan local files are never deleted automatically.
sv update and sv sync mark missing sources as orphan.
Reappearing sources reattach without manual manifest editing.

tasks.title: Implement sv status for project context
tasks.objective: Add context-aware sv status output for normal project repos.
steps: Find nearest Git root and inspect .sv/manifest.toml and .sv/index.toml.
For normal projects, show installed sv-managed skills with agent/target path, source, local modified state, remote update availability, and orphan state.
Keep unmanaged/manual skills out of managed bulk operation output unless explicitly relevant.
acceptance: sv status in a normal project shows managed Pi skills and state flags.
Modified/update-available/orphan states are understandable.
Manual unmanaged skills are not presented as managed.

tasks.title: Implement sv status for vault and global contexts
tasks.objective: Complete sv status behavior for skill-vault repos and outside-project contexts.
steps: In skill-vault repos, show root vault skills, source, edits, updates, orphan state, index freshness, and README generated-block freshness.
Outside any Git/project context, show global source status from ~/.sv/manifest.toml.
Keep output scriptable in non-TTY mode.
acceptance: sv status in a vault reports index and README freshness.
sv status outside a project reports configured source health.
Context detection is covered by tests.

tasks.title: Improve duplicate add resolution with source paths
tasks.objective: Resolve duplicate skill names by repo/path/description without forcing normal users to type paths in TTY mode.
steps: When sv add <skill> has multiple source matches, show interactive choices in TTY and fail with exact scriptable choices in non-TTY.
For same-repo same-name duplicates, show full source path in choices.
Retain qualified references for non-interactive use.
acceptance: TTY duplicate sv add offers a clear chooser.
Non-TTY duplicate sv add fails with repo/path/scriptable choices.
Same repo duplicate source paths are distinguishable.

tasks.title: Implement add-all and list picker command changes
tasks.objective: Finish sv add --all, sv add --all --repo, and sv add -l behavior while removing special sv add all behavior.
steps: Treat sv add all as a normal skill name instead of the all alias.
Support sv add --all and sv add --all --repo <repo-id> with duplicate handling.
Make sv add -l use multi-select and resolve selected duplicate skill names before copying.
acceptance: sv add all looks for a skill literally named all.
sv add --all --repo installs all valid skills from one source.
Selected duplicates are resolved before any local files are changed.

tasks.title: Implement vault replacement prompts and --replace
tasks.objective: Handle existing target paths safely in skill-vault mode.
steps: When a vault skill target already exists, prompt for replacement in TTY mode.
Require --replace for non-TTY replacement.
Warn when local edits are detected before replacement.
acceptance: TTY vault add prompts before replacing an existing skill.
Non-TTY vault add refuses replacement unless --replace is provided.
Local edit warnings are shown before destructive replacement.

tasks.title: Implement managed removal flows
tasks.objective: Add interactive and bulk removal behavior that never removes unmanaged skills accidentally.
steps: Implement sv remove -l multi-select with Skill, target path, and source/orphan status rows plus confirmation.
Implement sv remove --all to remove only manifest-managed skills, with TTY confirmation and non-TTY --yes requirement.
Implement sv repo remove -l multi-select repo removal with confirmation.
acceptance: Bulk remove ignores manual/unmanaged skill folders.
Non-TTY sv remove --all requires --yes.
Repo removal picker confirms before changing config.

tasks.title: Choose and encapsulate the TTY UI approach
tasks.objective: Make a deliberate terminal UI dependency decision and isolate UI code behind testable primitives.
steps: Compare current stdlib selector/table code against lightweight dependency options in the context of cross-platform UX, tiny install, and fast delivery.
Prefer no new runtime dependency unless tests show current approach cannot meet the first target.
Encapsulate the chosen approach so command handlers remain simple and non-TTY output stays separate.
acceptance: The chosen UI approach is reflected in code structure and tests.
No broad dependency is added without a clear reason.
Non-TTY behavior remains independent of TTY rendering.

tasks.title: Build reusable interactive table and picker primitives
tasks.objective: Support the common TTY list/search/repo/add/remove UX with aligned columns, filtering, details, and checkbox selection.
steps: Add read-only table navigation with headers, highlighted current row, one-line truncation, range/count footer, and q cancel/back.
Add checkbox multi-select picker without numeric row prefixes.
Add slash filtering and Enter details hooks where appropriate.
acceptance: Pickers use checkboxes and no numeric prefixes.
Read-only tables use a highlighted current row and footer help.
Slash filtering works in tested selector/table states.

tasks.title: Wire interactive list/search/repo browsing views
tasks.objective: Use the reusable TTY primitives for sv list, sv search, sv repo list, and sv repo -l.
steps: Make TTY sv list show Skill, Source, Description rows with details on Enter.
Make TTY sv search show an interactive filtered table with details on Enter.
Make TTY sv repo list and sv repo -l open a repo browser where Enter shows repo skills and supports install one/all/filter/back.
acceptance: TTY list/search/repo list are interactive by default.
Non-TTY list/search/repo list keep plain/scriptable output.
Repo skill view can install one skill or all skills from that repo.

tasks.title: Add sv repo -l alias and svx console script
tasks.objective: Add command aliases requested by the PLAN without adding unsupported aliases.
steps: Make sv repo -l an exact alias for sv repo list.
Add svx <repo> console script equivalent to sv repo add <repo>.
Do not add sv add repo <repo> as an alias.
acceptance: sv repo -l behaves like sv repo list in TTY and non-TTY contexts.
svx owner/repo calls the repo-add flow and returns matching output/errors.
CLI help and package metadata include the new script.

tasks.title: Add Epic 1 end-to-end acceptance coverage
tasks.objective: Cover the complete first implementation target with realistic end-to-end and contract tests.
steps: Add E2E tests for indexed sources, generic fallback, explicit skills paths, materialization, manifests, vault mode, update/sync/orphan/status, and command changes.
Use fake backends or local fixtures to avoid network dependence.
Keep security tests for path traversal, symlinks, and control characters green.
acceptance: Acceptance criteria from PLAN.md Epic 1 are represented in tests where feasible.
Tests do not require external network access.
Coverage remains aligned with the existing project threshold.
checks: Run full test suite if feasible

tasks.title: Polish CLI help and user-facing error contracts
tasks.objective: Ensure implemented Epic 1 commands are discoverable and produce actionable output without broad Epic 4 docs work.
steps: Update CLI help text for sv init, sv index, sv search, sv status, sv add --all --repo, sv remove --all, sv repo -l, sv repo remove -l, and svx where applicable.
Tighten user-facing errors for auth/rate-limit fallback, missing Git, duplicate choices, unsupported schemas, and non-TTY confirmation requirements.
Only touch README if current command examples become wrong; avoid Epic 4 quick-start expansion.
acceptance: CLI help lists implemented commands and important flags accurately.
Error messages are actionable and safe from control-character injection.
No deferred Epic 3/4 scope is accidentally implemented.

deferred_out_of_scope.reason: Agent adapter research and cross-agent support are explicitly out of the first implementation target.
Quality hardening is a later roadmap epic, except where tests are necessary for Epic 1 changes.
Installer, release, docs, governance, and branch protection are explicitly outside the first implementation target.
